description: This file defines the language management module for CKEditor, including supported languages, language detection, and dynamic loading of language files.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.lang
classes.description: Object managing language support, detection, and dynamic loading for CKEditor.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific language file or auto detects the language, then executes a callback with the language data.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Detects the user's language based on browser settings and returns the best matching language code.
